contract.title: Wave A: ranking-policy-identity.ts baseline/learned IDs and reranker_disabled_v1
contract.invariant: Disabled learned mode uses the canonical built-in reranker identity reranker_disabled_v1 and never inherits a configured provider identity. Composite policy identity search_ranking_policy_v3:<artifact-sha256> is carried by the existing rankingPolicyIdentity field.
production_callers: (no base runtime caller; Wave F consumers per §7.2: F6 selector+config, F7 ranked-set identity, F8 shadow sink)
interface_changes: packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-policy-identity.ts (new file; baseline/learned policy IDs and canonical built-in reranker_disabled_v1 per §5.7:1331-1338)
security_boundaries: Security boundary (explicit): disabled mode must emit canonical built-in reranker_disabled_v1 and NEVER inherit a configured provider identity (§5.7:1335, §7.6 A7 RED row disabled_mode_uses_reranker_disabled_v1, §8.8:2482); provider_derived mode uses the exact qualified reranker identity from the registry entry
overlap_with: F6/F7/F8 (Wave F): consume A7 identity (F6 requires A7; F7 requires F6, A7; F8 requires F6, A7)
R1.4: activation contract index is a sealed authority input
contract.instructions: Create packages/mcp/src/core/ranking-policy-identity.ts (new file) with baseline/learned policy IDs and the canonical built-in reranker identity reranker_disabled_v1. §7.5 A7 row: 'baseline/learned IDs and reranker_disabled_v1'. §7.6 A7 RED row: test 'disabled_mode_uses_reranker_disabled_v1'; expected failure: disabled mode inherits a configured provider identity; minimal passing: canonical disabled identity is emitted. Normative source: §5.7:1331-1338 — composite policy identity search_ranking_policy_v3:<artifact-sha256> carried by the existing rankingPolicyIdentity field of the ranked-set binding; for learned mode disabled, the binding's reranker identity is the canonical built-in value reranker_disabled_v1, never copied from an unrelated configured provider; for provider_derived, the exact qualified reranker identity from the registry entry. Policy hash appears in startup diagnostics, search diagnostics, and ranked-set bindings, not in index publication receipts. This is an explicit security boundary — do not weaken it. Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A7 row) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command pnpm --filter @zokizuan/satori-mcp test is repo-verified and must pass.
